name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his mandatory military service, where he worked as a mechanic on transport vehicles. His meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving skills quickly became apparent. After completing his service, he pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on precision manufacturing. His academic work eventually led him to an internship with a small Korean racing team, where he quickly rose through the ranks.

Jae-Hyun's approach to quality control is holistic; he believes that quality isn't just about meeting specifications but about understanding the entire ecosystem of the racing team. He is known for his ability to identify potential problems before they manifest, often finding innovative solutions to complex challenges. His distinctive ability to see the big picture, coupled with his deep understanding of technical details, makes him an invaluable asset to Andretti Global.

His leadership style emphasizes collaboration and continuous improvement. He fosters a culture of open communication and encourages his team to challenge conventional thinking. Jae-Hyun sees quality control as a proactive function that drives performance and pushes the boundaries of what's possible.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and notes.
